newsitem.title: JAPAN: Denki Kagaku shares up on bright forecast.
newsitem.headline: Denki Kagaku shares up on bright forecast.

text.p: Shares of Denki Kagaku Kogyo KK rose in heavy trade on Monday morning, supported by its bright earnings forecast for the current business year that ends in March 1998, brokers said.

At 0124 GMT, the share price of the chemicals maker was up 30 yen at 310, making it the third largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. It briefly hit 313 yen, a high for this calendar year.
Its share turnover of 3.86 million was the second heaviest on the first section.
Denki Kagaku said on Friday that it expects a parent current profit of 8.0 billion yen for the year to March 31, 1998, against an actual parent current profit of 4.66 billion last fiscal year.
